# CI 与发布

## 核心概念

**CI 与发布**把"打标签"变成"自动产出多平台发布物"的流水线。典型链路是：推送 Git 标签 → 触发 CI → 矩阵构建多平台二进制 → 生成 Changelog → 创建 GitHub Release。

| 环节       | 关键机制                | 目的                 |
| ---------- | ----------------------- | -------------------- |
| 触发       | `on: push: tags: v*`    | 以标签为发布开关     |
| 矩阵构建   | `strategy.matrix`       | 一次产出多平台产物   |
| Changelog  | git-cliff 按提交生成    | 免手工整理变更       |
| 发布自动化 | `permissions`、上传产物 | 可复现地创建 Release |

设计目标是**发布可复现、无需人工干预**：同一标签应总能得到相同的产物集合。本文从 GitHub Actions 工作流讲到矩阵构建与 Changelog。

---

## GitHub Actions Release 工作流

**GitHub Actions** 为 CLI 工具的自动化构建和发布提供了完整的 CI/CD 能力。典型的发布流程是：推送 Git 标签 → 触发 CI → 多平台构建 → 创建 GitHub Release。

```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-latest
            archive: tar.gz
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-latest
            archive: tar.gz
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
            archive: tar.gz
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
            archive: tar.gz
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
            archive: zip

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Package (Unix)
        if: matrix.archive == 'tar.gz'
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          tar czf ../../../mytool-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz mytool
          cd ../../..

      - name: Package (Windows)
        if: matrix.archive == 'zip'
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          7z a ../../../mytool-${{ matrix.target }}.zip mytool.exe
          cd ../../..

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mytool-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: mytool-${{ matrix.target }}.*

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: mytool-*
          generate_release_notes: true
```

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[git tag v1.0.0] --> B[push tag]
    B --> C[GitHub Actions 触发]
    C --> D[矩阵构建]
    D --> E[Linux x86_64]
    D --> F[Linux ARM64]
    D --> G[macOS x86_64]
    D --> H[macOS ARM64]
    D --> I[Windows x86_64]
    E --> J[上传 artifact]
    F --> J
    G --> J
    H --> J
    I --> J
    J --> K[创建 GitHub Release]
    K --> L[发布二进制文件]
```

## 矩阵构建

**矩阵构建**（Matrix Build）同时在多个平台和配置上运行构建任务，确保 CLI 工具在所有目标环境中都能正确工作。

| 维度      | 选项                   | 说明       |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ---------- |
| 操作系统  | ubuntu, macos, windows | 构建环境   |
| 目标架构  | x86_64, aarch64        | CPU 架构   |
| 链接方式  | gnu, musl, msvc        | C 库实现   |
| Rust 版本 | stable, nightly        | 编译器版本 |

```rust
fn print_build_matrix() {
    let targets = vec![
        ("Linux x86_64", "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl", "ubuntu-latest"),
        ("Linux ARM64", "aarch64-unknown-linux-musl", "ubuntu-latest"),
        ("macOS Intel", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "macos-latest"),
        ("macOS ARM", "aarch64-apple-darwin", "macos-latest"),
        ("Windows", "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "windows-latest"),
    ];

    println!("{:<15} {:<35} {}", "平台", "Target Triple", "Runner");
    println!("{}", "-".repeat(70));
    for (name, target, runner) in &targets {
        println!("{:<15} {:<35} {}", name, target, runner);
    }
}

fn main() {
    print_build_matrix();
}
```

> **提示：** ARM64 Linux 的交叉编译需要额外的工具链。使用 `cross` 工具或在 CI 中安装 `gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu` 来处理。

## Changelog 自动生成

**Changelog**（变更日志）让用户了解每个版本的变化。**git-cliff** 和 **conventional commits** 是自动化 changelog 的主流方案。

```toml
# cliff.toml - git-cliff 配置
[changelog]
header = "# 变更日志\n\n"
body = """
{% for group, commits in commits | group_by(attribute="group") %}
### {{ group | upper_first }}
{% for commit in commits %}
- {{ commit.message | upper_first }} ({{ commit.id | truncate(length=7, end="") }})
{% endfor %}
{% endfor %}
"""
trim = true

[git]
conventional_commits = true
commit_parsers = [
    { message = "^feat", group = "✨ 新功能" },
    { message = "^fix", group = "🐛 修复" },
    { message = "^perf", group = "⚡ 性能" },
    { message = "^refactor", group = "♻️ 重构" },
    { message = "^doc", group = "📝 文档" },
    { message = "^ci", group = "👷 CI" },
]
```

| 工具                   | 语言    | 特点                 |
| ---------------------- | ------- | -------------------- |
| git-cliff              | Rust    | 高度可配置，模板驱动 |
| conventional-changelog | Node.js | 社区标准             |
| release-please         | Node.js | GitHub 自动化 PR     |
| changesets             | Node.js | Monorepo 友好        |

## 发布流程自动化

完整的发布流程应最大限度地自动化，减少人工操作。

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

VERSION=$1
if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "用法: ./release.sh <version>"
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== 发布 v$VERSION ==="

echo "1. 更新版本号..."
sed -i '' "s/^version = \".*\"/version = \"$VERSION\"/" Cargo.toml
cargo check

echo "2. 生成 changelog..."
git-cliff --tag "v$VERSION" -o CHANGELOG.md

echo "3. 提交变更..."
git add Cargo.toml Cargo.lock CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "chore: release v$VERSION"

echo "4. 创建标签..."
git tag -a "v$VERSION" -m "Release v$VERSION"

echo "5. 推送..."
git push origin main --tags

echo "=== 完成! CI 将自动构建和发布 ==="
```

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[更新版本号] --> B[生成 Changelog]
    B --> C[提交 + 标签]
    C --> D[推送到 GitHub]
    D --> E[CI 自动构建]
    E --> F[创建 Release]
```

## 小结

```mermaid
mindmap
  root((CI 与发布))
    GitHub Actions
      tag 触发
      矩阵构建
      Release 创建
    矩阵构建
      多操作系统
      多架构
      artifact 上传
    Changelog
      git-cliff
      conventional commits
      自动生成
    发布流程
      版本号更新
      标签推送
      自动化脚本
```

- GitHub Actions 的 tag 触发模式是 CLI 工具发布的标准流程
- 矩阵构建同时覆盖 Linux、macOS、Windows 三大平台和 x86_64、ARM64 两种架构
- git-cliff 基于 conventional commits 自动生成结构化的 changelog
- 发布流程应自动化为脚本，减少人工操作中的遗漏和错误
- `softprops/action-gh-release` 自动创建 GitHub Release 并附加预编译二进制
